description: Rewrites one of the owner's own words about the business that every plan, post and page reads, as the owner's save on Brand does: what it is, who it's for or how it talks. The whole field is replaced, so read it first with get_brand. Returns the field and the words saved. A fact that is wrong goes in owner_fact_set instead; the look and design rules are business_context_change.

field.description: description: what the business is; audience: who it's for; voice: how it talks.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

text.description: The field's new words, whole; never empty.

name: update_brand
title: Update the brand's words
